limits.detail: SF2 data alone cannot establish loader tolerance, actual timbre, note/controller timing, voice stealing, host bank mapping, sample-rate conversion, effects or audible loop artifacts. No MIDI tracks in R to identify actual preset usage.

Game.exe and DLL function bodies not exhaustively interpreted. All PE fields/imports/exports/COFF names and DWARF interface metadata are not a proof of internal native behavior; supplied formats/tools do permit some further reverse engineering, so this is not claimed absolutely undecodable.

All animmaker declared IL bodies are statically read; CLR/.NET2.0 libraries, drawing/codec/filesystem/XML runtime outcomes remain unexecuted. Numerical API labels from documentation are not R implementation evidence.
extendtext identified request loop is read, but CRT startup/OS calls/scheduling/window ownership/title localization/DPI and visible effects are not verified.

Game.exe contains three readable RPG compatibility blocks (offsets10704000/10726432/10749504, sizes22410/23043/38461),29 detected long shader blocks,26 other printable multiline blocks; interface names/input names are inventoried and audio tails read. Non-audio script bodies/shader arithmetic/other data beyond assigned interface scope are not individually semantically certified. Unselected native string candidates are scanned inventory, not full content review. These must never be rolled into a blanket opaque or full-read claim.

dwarfdump --debug-info succeeded for64 MinGW CRT/support units in RubyDLL. Optional --verify did not return and was interrupted with control-C; no pass/fail conclusion. Debug location expressions, unwind/relocation/TLS execution and types as full ABI equivalence are not interpreted. COFF symbols and long section names remain readable and decoded.

Standard-library bounded parsers target fixedR SF2/PE/CLI records. Every encountered opcode/signature/table is decoded; unsupported shapes fail. This is not universal SF2/PE/CLI conformance or a sandbox for arbitrary hostile files. All comparisons/mutations concern parser validation, not reference/model/host behavior execution.

Existing8-font cmap/metrics/contactsheet and2-BMP evidence consumed as context. RES does not repeat the same parsing/rendering. TrueType bytecode/composite programs/native font selection/hinting and rendered UX remain outside inherited proof.
Requested gpt-6-astra/ultra/service_tier=default,Fast forbidden; no actual runtime echo available. No quota/auth/private-session/backend/global-config audit; no spawned agents or model sessions.

tool_availability.consequence: Custom data parsers filled SF2/managed metadata/IL gaps; no installation. No second independent CLI decoder available.

external_material: E-mu SF2.01 format; ECMA CLI; Microsoft PE/API docs used only to interpret format and call signatures, never substituted for R bodies. No media downloaded.
execution_accounting: Safe authored parsers/system object-file readers = TOOL_VALIDATION. No source from R imported/executed, no IL interpreter/JIT, no synthesizer/renderer/Game.exe/DLL loading, no reference behavior model.
